Step3. Calculate DEGs

1 Load libraries

Load the necessary libraries.

library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)

2 Load data

Load se object:

se <- readRDS("data/human_brain_cortex/Seurat_objects/Metaspots_normalized.rds")
se
## An object of class Seurat 
## 22762 features across 352 samples within 2 assays 
## Active assay: SCT (11381 features, 3000 variable features)
##  3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data
##  1 other assay present: RNA
table(se$cluster_anno)
## 
##  0  1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8 
## 68 63 49 47 40 34 30 17  4

3 QC metrics

Collect QC metrics

se[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(se, pattern = "^MT-")
se[["percent.rb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(se, pattern = "^RPL|^RPS")

Plot QC metrics

VlnPlot(se, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rb"), ncol = 1, group.by = "cluster_anno")

RidgePlot(se, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rb"), ncol = 1, group.by = "cluster_anno")
## Picking joint bandwidth of 897
## Picking joint bandwidth of 13100
## Picking joint bandwidth of 0.886
## Picking joint bandwidth of 0.299

4 DEGs

DE analysis, for all clusters.

se
## An object of class Seurat 
## 22762 features across 352 samples within 2 assays 
## Active assay: SCT (11381 features, 3000 variable features)
##  3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data
##  1 other assay present: RNA
DefaultAssay(se) <- "RNA"
se
## An object of class Seurat 
## 22762 features across 352 samples within 2 assays 
## Active assay: RNA (11381 features, 0 variable features)
##  1 layer present: counts
##  1 other assay present: SCT
#se <- JoinLayers(se)
#se

se <- se %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  ScaleData() 
## Normalizing layer: counts
## Centering and scaling data matrix
se <- SetIdent(se, value = "cluster_anno")
N.markers <- FindAllMarkers(se, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25,slot = "data")
## Calculating cluster 0
## Calculating cluster 1
## Calculating cluster 2
## Calculating cluster 3
## Calculating cluster 4
## Calculating cluster 5
## Calculating cluster 6
## Calculating cluster 7
## Calculating cluster 8

Save N.markers

write.table(N.markers,file="data/human_brain_cortex/DEG_output/DE_genes.csv", col.names = T, row.names = F,quote = FALSE,sep = ";")

5 Heatmap

Select top N genes to plot

N <- 10

topN <- N.markers %>% 
            group_by(cluster) %>% 
            arrange(cluster,p_val_adj) %>%
            slice_head(n=N)
topN

Plot heat map of top N genes in each cluster:

DoHeatmap(se, features = topN$gene)

PDF

pdf(file = "data/human_brain_cortex/DEG_output/DEG_Heatmap_top10.pdf", height = 40, width = 20)

DoHeatmap(se, features = topN$gene)
